entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Blue-white-black shard of Alara defined by control, whose creatures are infused with etherium.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: Magical alloy infused in the bodies of all Esper creatures, a polished filigree that replaces flesh; supplies are dwindling.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Mages of human, vedalken and sphinx races dedicated to infusing all life on Esper with etherium in the Noble Work.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Mages who claim to know the secret of etherium and keep it in the Filigree Texts in a secret chamber.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: Red stone said to be crucial to etherium creation; no new sources found on Esper.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Sphinx possibly a planeswalker, tied to the origin of etherium, blamed by the Ethersworn for aether-liches and disappeared.

entities.name: Aether-liches
entities.description: Terrible creatures resulting from an over-application of etherium.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Etherium-infused mage of Esper and artificer-planeswalker in Agents of Artifice.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose rise from mage-prodigy is told in Agents of Artifice.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Black-aligned planeswalker featured in Agents of Artifice.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Biomechanical invaders whose union of metal and flesh differs from Esper's goals.

events.summary: The Ethersworn are running out of etherium and must reclaim it from dead creatures, putting Esper in an etherium crisis.
events.quote: In essence, Esper is undergoing an etherium crisis.

events.summary: The Ethersworn blame Crucius for aether-liches, and he disappears as an enemy of the plane.
events.quote: The Ethersworn blamed Crucius for etherium abominations called aether-liches

relations.note: They blamed him for the aether-liches.
relations.quote: The Ethersworn blamed Crucius for etherium abominations called aether-liches
